record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: Let x in X be a 2n-dimensional symplectic singularity with symplectic form omega_X. If one takes the stable degeneration x_0 in X_0 provided by the normalized-volume theory, is X_0 again symplectic, with a symplectic form omega_{X_0} obtained as a degeneration of omega_X?

evidence.quote:
Problem 20. For a 2n-dimensional symplectic singularity x ∈ X, and any symplectic form ωX,
the stable degeneration x0 ∈ X0 is also symplectic with the symplectic form ωX0 degeneration
of ωX.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. Let $x \in X$ be a germ of a normal complex algebraic variety of dimension $2n$. Recall that $(X,x)$ is called a symplectic singularity (in the sense of Beauville) if the smooth locus $X^{\mathrm{sm}}$ carries a holomorphic symplectic 2-form $\omega_X$ such that, for some (equivalently any) resolution of singularities $\pi:\widetilde X 	o X$, the pullback $\pi^*\omega_X$ extends to a holomorphic 2-form on $\widetilde X$. In particular such an $X$ has klt singularities.

For a klt singularity $x \in X$, the Stable Degeneration Theorem (formerly the Li–Xu Stable Degeneration Conjecture) produces a canonical two-step degeneration
$$ x \in X \;ightsquigarrow\; x_0 \in X_0 $$
as follows. The normalized volume function $\widehat{\mathrm{vol}}_{X,x}$ on the space of valuations centered at $x$ admits a (quasi-monomial) minimizer $v$, unique up to scaling. The associated graded ring $\mathrm{gr}_v \mathcal O_{X,x}$ is finitely generated, and $X_0 := \mathrm{Spec}\,\mathrm{gr}_v \mathcal O_{X,x}$ together with the vertex $x_0$ is a K-semistable log Fano cone singularity equipped with a natural torus action. This $x_0 \in X_0$ is called the stable degeneration of $x \in X$.

Problem. Suppose $x \in X$ is a $2n$-dimensional symplectic singularity with symplectic form $\omega_X$ on $X^{\mathrm{sm}}$, and let $x_0 \in X_0$ be its stable degeneration in the sense above. Show that $X_0$ is again a symplectic singularity, and moreover that there exists a holomorphic symplectic form $\omega_{X_0}$ on $X_0^{\mathrm{sm}}$ which arises as a degeneration of $\omega_X$ under the canonical degeneration $X ightsquigarrow X_0$ (i.e., as the leading term of $\omega_X$ in the filtration induced by the minimizing valuation $v$).
artifact.status_search_result: The general Stable Degeneration Conjecture for klt singularities has been established (Blum; Li–Xu; Xu; Xu–Zhuang). However, the refined question of whether the stable degeneration of a symplectic singularity is again symplectic, with symplectic form obtained as a degeneration of the original one, does not appear to be resolved in the literature; it is listed as an open problem in current surveys on K-stability of Fano varieties and symplectic singularities. No paper claiming a proof or counterexample was located.

status_evidence.title: Stable degenerations of singularities
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes finite generation completing the Stable Degeneration Conjecture for klt singularities; does not address symplectic forms.
status_evidence.claim: The general stable degeneration framework for klt singularities is now a theorem, but symplectic-preservation is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: A guided tour to normalized volume
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of normalized volume and stable degeneration; discusses examples but does not establish that stable degenerations of symplectic singularities are symplectic.
status_evidence.claim: The symplectic refinement of the stable degeneration is left as a question/expectation.

status_evidence.title: KIAS Lectures on Symplectic Aspects of Degenerations
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses symplectic structures under degenerations but does not resolve the K-stability stable-degeneration question for symplectic singularities.
status_evidence.claim: No proof of preservation of symplectic form under K-stable normalized-volume degeneration is given.
